question_text: Which areas of the venue had the most crowd activity? Rank them by their average crowd size.

citations.cypher:
CALL {
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)
  WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  RETURN ch.camera_location AS location, AVG(ch.avg_hc) AS avg_crowd_size
  WITH location, avg_crowd_size
}
RETURN location, avg_crowd_size ORDER BY avg_crowd_size DESC
